annotations.title: Check if a process is running

description: Check if a process is running on the user's Windows machine — no screenshot. Filter by executable name fragment (e.g. "python", "ffmpeg") and/or window title (e.g. "RENDER VIDEO 02"). Returns PID, CPU%, RAM, title, command line, start time. Command lines are truncated to 120 chars unless full_command_line=true. Results are capped at 10 matches, windowed processes first.

full_command_line.description: true for full command line (default: truncated to 120 chars)

name: check_process
